answer: Before an identity can attest or grade, it posts a bond and lands an epoch answer. Only then does a delayed lottery name three established graders whose pairwise co-attestation overlap in the last two checkpoints stays under a hard cap. Each must quote one reproducible step and score 0-3; a median below two, or a near-copy of earlier text, slashes the bond and bars later panel seats. That delay is a canyon a pre-stacked jury cannot cross. What survives is a walnut of checkable procedure, turned through a spiral of low-overlap reviewers a fresh-key swarm cannot cheaply imitate.
